question: Gurpurab is celebrated by which of the following community ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gurpurab** is celebrated by the **Sikh** community.
 
• It marks the **birth anniversaries of the ten Sikh Gurus**.
 
• The most significant Gurpurab is the birth anniversary of **Guru Nanak**, the founder of Sikhism, known as **Guru Nanak Jayanti**.
 
• Gurpurabs are observed with a series of religious activities including **prayers, processions, and community service**.
 
• Sikhs around the world participate in **Akhand Path** (a continuous reading of the Guru Granth Sahib) and **Langar** (community kitchen) during these celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Guru Granth Sahib** is the central religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign, and eternal living Guru.
 
• Sikhism was founded in the late 15th century in the Punjab region of South Asia, which is now divided between India and Pakistan.
 
• The core teachings of Sikhism include the belief in **one God, equality of all human beings, and selfless service** to humanity.
 
• Sikh places of worship are called **Gurdwaras**, where the Sikh community gathers for congregational worship and community service.
